strings.name: Christopher Nassetta
strings.summary: Nassetta moved from commercial-property development into hotel-asset management and led Host Hotels before becoming Hilton president and CEO in 2007. After the financial crisis he reorganized operations and brands, led the 2013 listing and 2017 property and timeshare separations, and developed a management-and-franchise model. His influence spans international hospitality, travel and organizational management.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Long led Hilton, advancing international hotel-brand expansion, management and operations, and travel services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in 1962 in Arlington, Virginia, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Finance bachelor’s, Virginia’s McIntire School(1984); international-finance coursework at LSE.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Hilton operations
strings.highlights.h1.text: Reorganized operations and brand management after the crisis, expanding international management and franchising.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Listing and separations
strings.highlights.h2.text: Oversaw Hilton’s listing and separation of property and timeshare businesses into independent companies.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Business separations
strings.timeline.t1.text: Hilton completed Park Hotels and Hilton Grand Vacations separations, focusing on management and franchising.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Hilton listing
strings.timeline.t2.text: Led the return to public capital markets.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Hilton president and CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: Moved from Host to Hilton, beginning in December.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Host chief executive
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became president and CEO of Host Hotels & Resorts.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Host chief operating officer
strings.timeline.t5.text: Promoted to COO after joining the company.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Host
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became executive vice president in the hotel-asset business.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founded Bailey
strings.timeline.t7.text: Helped establish property-investment and advisory firm Bailey Capital.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Finance education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed Virginia’s finance degree and entered commercial-property development.
